rules.rule: State the mechanism. No moral vocabulary, no verdict, no hero or villain.
Assert; drop softeners and padding when the cut is structural.
Negation differentiates. Never assertively negate a rival take; only a closed-reality assumption may be negated outright.
Embody, never claim: do not teach, persuade, reassure or brand, and do not announce the stance.
No collective address and no lecturing down to the viewer.
Will and agency belong only to living Minds; a model, market, system or tool never decides, wants, tries or acts.
Locate a theory's boundary; never show or call it refuted. Scaffolding strains at its limit, it does not shatter.
Matter is friction between model and reality, and an objective fact is an invariant across subjective cognitions; nothing on screen stands as the final, mind-independent truth.
Open residue, never a finished product or ground truth: the ending closes no question.
A title or section label names the cut of that moment; none of the generic closers listed at the source.
Title is post line 1 and subtitle is post line 3, verbatim, split at the first ' / '; no delimiter added.
Strict language separation: one language per cut, in narration, captions and every label.
The house premise formula, when used, is the source text verbatim; it is not forced where the post names the Mind without it.
Prose over lists: an argument step is never carried by a bullet list, stat card or text panel.
Stand alone: carry this post's cut; do not narrate linked essays or collapse it into a neighbour.
Unicode maths only: no raw $ or LaTeX, no emoji, no markdown syntax on screen.
Zero banned zh words, in every string of a zh cut.
The only URL anywhere is the canonical post URL, trailing slash included.
Rigorous, contemplative, spacious: no frantic pacing, flashy montage cuts or melodramatic score.

file_video_stream.unit: ffprobe video stream: width and height for the cut's aspect, r_frame_rate, codec_name, profile, pix_fmt; color_space, color_transfer and color_primaries each equal to video.color; color_range tv

file_audio_stream.unit: ffprobe audio stream: codec, rate, channels

file_frame_count.unit: frames between the counted video frames and window.__meta.frames

file_av_drift.unit: frames between the audio and video stream durations

file_decode_errors.unit: lines printed by a full decode at -v error

file_fidelity.unit: dB PSNR over every sample, decoded video frame against its own capture after the same conversion to video.pix_fmt and video.color with no encoder, minimum over the sampled frames

file_gop.unit: s, longest interval between keyframes (ffprobe key_frame=1)

file_faststart.unit: moov atom ahead of mdat (1 yes, 0 no)

audio_loudness.unit: LU either side of audio.lufs, integrated loudness of the master mix (ebur128)

audio_true_peak.unit: dBTP, true peak of the master mix (ebur128 peak=true)

audio_length.unit: samples of the film's length (timeline.seconds in whole frames, at audio.rate) that the master mix, a stem of it or the sound decoded from the MP4 is short of or over, plus the samples of the params.window_s windows in which the MP4's sound and the master differ by more than params.codec_db dBFS

audio_accent_coverage.unit: share of section changes (beat boundaries where the argument step changes) with a sound accent within params.frames frames

render_determinism.unit: differing pixels between two captures of the same frame, on params.frames frames, one of them mid camera move when the film has a 3D beat

render_network.unit: requests to any non-local origin during capture

render_fonts.unit: required faces missing, by glyph-width probe against the generic families

render_blank_frames.unit: frames whose peak luma, on the 0-255 full-range scale, is no more than params.margin above that of palette.ground

script_beat_fields.unit: beats with an empty steps, narration, visual start, driver or end, plus 3D beats (those that state a third_axis) with an empty carrier or camera purpose

script_step_coverage.unit: argument steps carried by no beat, plus beats citing no step

script_fact_lock.unit: strings failing the trace: a quote that differs from its post_line; a cited post_line that does not exist; a number in digits, narrated or on screen, absent from the post's text in that language; an on-screen string without post_line found in neither the narration nor exaggerations

script_title_verbatim.unit: characters differing between a shown title or subtitle and its half of post line 1 or 3

script_banned_en.unit: hits of voice.banned_en, as whole words and phrases, case-insensitive, in narration, captions and on-screen text of an en cut; the verbatim title and subtitle excepted

script_banned_zh.unit: hits of the list at voice.banned_zh_source in narration, captions and on-screen text of a zh cut

script_markup.unit: occurrences in any string of $, a backslash command, an emoji (Unicode Emoji_Presentation) or a markdown marker (asterisk, backtick, leading #, [text](url))

script_language_mix.unit: strings containing the other cut's script: CJK characters in an en cut; in a zh cut, Latin letters outside all-capital acronyms and the end-card URL

script_only_url.unit: every URL in narration, captions or overlay, with <slug> filled

type_caption_latin.unit: px, computed font size of Latin captions

type_caption_cjk.unit: px, computed font size of CJK captions

type_body.unit: px, computed font size of title, claim and quote text

type_label.unit: px, computed font size of anchored labels

type_minimum.unit: px, computed font size of any text, notes included

text_contrast.unit: :1, lowest contrast between a text box's computed colour and the rendered pixels behind it, that text hidden

text_overlaps.unit: pairs of overlapping text boxes at any sampled frame

text_safe_margin.unit: % of the frame, smallest inset of any text box from any frame edge

text_caption_band.unit: % of frame height, smallest gap from the bottom edge to any non-caption text box

text_static_words.unit: words on screen at once, captions excluded

text_block_static.unit: s a non-caption text block stays on screen unchanged

caption_sync.unit: s between a page's start and its first word's timestamp

caption_text.unit: characters differing between the joined caption pages and the script narration, whitespace ignored

caption_cps_latin.unit: characters per second per page, Latin

caption_cps_cjk.unit: characters per second per page, CJK

structure_narration_start.unit: s from frame 0 to the first narrated word

structure_claim_on_screen.unit: s from frame 0 until the first on-screen item with role claim is visible

structure_end_card_hold.unit: s the end card (verbatim title and URL) is held

motion_stage_freeze.unit: s, longest main-stage freeze in an ambient=0 render outside the end card, freezedetect noise at params.noise_db

motion_state_interval.unit: s, longest wait in an ambient=0 render before the main stage differs from a still by the qa.explain_subject_change threshold at the same per-pixel delta; stills taken every params.step_s and at each beat midpoint

motion_state_sync.unit: s between a visual state change and the narrated word it depicts

explain_subject_change.unit: share of main-stage pixels changing by more than params.delta of 255 between entry and exit of a subject-carrier beat, lockcam=1 ambient=0

review_rounds.unit: revision rounds after the first review

explain_mechanism.unit: beats whose main visual is not a mechanism: at least params.entities labelled entities, a relation shown by motion, a visible before and after

explain_camera_carrier.unit: camera-carrier beats where the reviewer cannot name the relation the move reveals

explain_cause_first.unit: beats whose effect is visible before its driver

explain_beat_earns_time.unit: beats removable without losing an argument step

depth_cues.unit: depth cues the reviewer can name on each 3D still

depth_lit_occluding.unit: 3D beats whose stills lack a shaded surface or an occlusion

depth_parallax.unit: camera moves where near objects do not shift more than far ones between stills params.pair_gap_s apart

depth_third_axis_readable.unit: beats whose stated third_axis cannot be read off the still

motion_camera_rest.unit: s the camera is at rest before a narrated key word and while text must be read

motion_orbit_rate.unit: degrees per second of camera orbit

motion_loop_repeats.unit: plays of any identical animation cycle

motion_hard_cuts.unit: hard cuts of the stage that are undeclared or unmotivated

motion_cut_pops.unit: pops, flicker or z-fighting in params.strip_frames-frame strips at each cut and at the fastest camera move

layout_text_crossed.unit: text crossed by a line or object, or clipped by the frame

layout_stage_coverage.unit: share of the frame covered by the main visual's bounding box at its peak

layout_empty_quadrant.unit: s any frame quadrant stays empty

layout_phone_sheet.unit: title, claim, caption or primary label unreadable on a still downscaled to params.width_px wide

structure_recap_frame.unit: frames before the end card that show the whole argument as one visual

faith_voice_rules.unit: violations of any voice.rules entry in narration, on-screen text or picture, reported by rule id

faith_untraced_claim.unit: names, quotes, figures, readouts or claims, in words or picture, that the post does not make

faith_colour_semantics.unit: accents outside palette.semantic or used against their meaning

faith_exaggerations.unit: visible exaggerations not listed in the script or not labelled on screen

faith_guard_rails.unit: script guard_rails the picture or narration breaks

faith_third_party.unit: third-party logos, real-person likenesses or imitated voices

faith_visual_family.unit: look carried over from another job

review_beat_stills.unit: full-resolution stills read per beat: entry, middle, exit

review_sheets.unit: s of runtime per contact sheet the reviewer has read

review_bursts.unit: frame bursts across transitions the reviewer has read

owner_style_frame.unit: owner approvals of the full-resolution style frame, before any animation

owner_playback.unit: full playbacks by the owner, start to end, with sound
